notes.title: EDEN.schemata(); Joining Tokyo Game Dungeon. Publisher & Release Date Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your continued support of EDEN.schemata();.

We would like to inform you that the publisher for this title has been changed to Alliance Arts.

While we had initially aimed for a Spring 2025 release, we have decided to shift the release window to Winter in order to further refine the game.

EDEN.schemata(); was originally scheduled to participate in the February 2025 Steam Next Fest, but after careful consideration, we believe it is best to let players experience the game once it has reached a more complete state. We sincerely apologize for the extended wait and greatly appreciate your continued patience.

At the same time, the development team is eager to receive feedback from players. To that end, we will be exhibiting EDEN.schemata(); at the upcoming live indie event, Tokyo Game Dungeon.
If you plan to attend, we would be thrilled to have you try the game and share your thoughts with us.

Alliance Arts
